verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a plugin marketplace/API, a local HTTP API server for external access to the graph, and a logseq:// protocol for third-party app integration—all of which are generic mechanisms that could support AI tool connectors, but no evidence names any first-party AI/LLM connector or specific AI plugin in the marketplace. Missing for 10: explicit first-party LLM integration, named AI plugins/examples, and any documentation of AI-specific use cases for the HTTP API or protocol.
